item.description:
Fixed

  • Link Report marks the exact approved https://www.facebook.com/esrigis link as "Auto Verified" with "Facebook" underneath instead of reporting Facebook's bot-check error.
  • Link Report action labels stay on one line in a separate, horizontally scrollable action row instead of wrapping in narrow windows, with actions aligned to the right.
  • Copy and Copy Image actions now show a temporary confirmation or error message above the status bar and announce it to assistive technology.
  • CTSS Mail preview branding now follows the workflow: Esri for Calcite, Globe, and Outlook; Maps.com only for the Maps.com workflow.
  • Globe preserves article CTA URLs when an editor adds a Related link in the same paragraph, with each link's URL on its own line.
  • Globe now separates the footer with a solid line instead of asterisks, and avoids repeating footer email addresses as mailto URLs.

Added

  • jetstream://updates opens Jetstream's Check for Updates flow from a link.

Changed

  • Save FWD Package now prompts for an email name and uses it for the ZIP, HTML, and PDF filenames rather than deriving it from the source or HTML title.

Added

  • Save FWD Package exports the FWD HTML, a matching single-page PDF, and a shortcut to the SharePoint guide on choosing PDF or HTML for sharing email.
  • Help > Export Diagnostics bundles local app state and saved hang reports without including source email content. A main-thread watchdog records unresponsive periods for troubleshooting.

Fixed

  • Review Images keeps selection edits local until the sheet closes and isolates unchanged rows to reduce SwiftUI view-graph work.
